读法说明. 带边框的卡片是英语原文, 左上角标出讲义页码 (Page N) 或幻灯片页码 (Slide N). 淡色底的框是中文讲解, 虚线框是补充, 红框标出原文错误. 讲义是主线, 幻灯片只补独特例题、图和讨论. 可疑数值与新增换算已用 Python 核对; 本讲没有需要运行的 R 代码.

Beta 分布与归一化
The Beta Distribution and Normalization

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Be familiar with the 2-parameter family of beta distributions and its normalization.
  2. Understand the benefits of conjugate priors.
  3. Be able to update a beta prior given a Bernoulli, binomial, or geometric likelihood.
  4. Understand and be able to use the formula for updating a normal prior given a normal likelihood with known variance.

本讲有四项目标: 熟悉 Beta 分布及其归一化; 理解共轭先验为什么方便; 会用 Bernoulli、二项或几何似然更新 Beta 先验; 会在数据方差已知时更新正态先验.

前三项围绕同一组「幂次相加」规则, 最后一项围绕「精度相加」规则. 学会以后, 很多贝叶斯更新不再需要重新计算积分.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1

Our main goal here is to introduce the idea of conjugate priors and look at some specific conjugate pairs. These simplify the job of Bayesian updating to simple arithmetic. We’ll start by introducing the beta distribution and using it as a conjugate prior with a binomial likelihood. After that we’ll look at other conjugate pairs.

本讲的核心是 **conjugate prior 共轭先验**. 某些先验族与似然搭配后, 后验仍留在原来的分布族中, 更新就退化成修改几个参数.

讲义先看 Beta 先验与二项似然, 再推广到 Bernoulli 和几何似然, 最后看正态先验与已知方差的正态似然. 重点不是背分布名称, 而是看懂乘积为什么仍保持原来的函数形式.

3 Beta 分布
3 Beta distribution

Page 1

The beta distribution Beta(a,b) is a two-parameter distribution with range [0,1] and pdf

f(θ)=(a−1)!(b−1)!(a+b−1)!​θa−1(1−θ)b−1.

**Beta distribution Beta 分布**是定义在 [0,1] 上的双参数分布, 很适合描述未知概率或比例 θ. 它的密度由两部分组成: 前面的常数负责归一化, 后面的 θa−1(1−θ)b−1 决定分布形状.

读这个公式时重点看两个幂次. 后面的共轭更新只会改变 a−1 与 b−1, 分布类型不会改变.

Page 1

We have made an applet so you can explore the shape of the beta distribution as you vary the parameters: https://mathlets.org/mathlets/beta-distribution/.

As you can see in the applet, the beta distribution may be defined for any real numbers a>0 and b>0. In 18.05 we will stick to integers a and b, but you can get the full story here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beta_distribution

Beta 分布实际允许任意实数 a>0,b>0, 本课为了使用阶乘形式的归一化常数, 主要取正整数. 课件提供的 applet 用来观察参数变化时曲线如何移动和集中.

例如 a=b=1 是均匀分布; a=b 且数值较大时, 质量更集中在 1/2 附近; 两个参数不等时, 分布会向较大参数对应的一侧倾斜.

Page 1

In the context of Bayesian updating, a and b are often called hyperparameters to distinguish them from the unknown parameter θ representing our hypotheses. In a sense, a and b are ‘one level up’ from θ since they parameterize its pdf.

这里的 a,b 叫 **hyperparameters 超参数**, 用来区别于真正未知的参数 θ. θ 描述数据生成机制, a,b 则描述我们对 θ 的先验判断.

所以说超参数「高一层」: 它们不是硬币本身的性质, 而是先验分布的形状控制量. 共轭更新正是根据数据修改这些超参数.

3.1 一个简单但重要的观察
3.1 A simple but important observation!

Pages 1–2

If a pdf f(θ) with range [0,1] has the form cθa−1(1−θ)b−1 then f(θ) is a Beta(a,b) distribution and the normalizing constant must be

c=(a−1)!(b−1)!(a+b−1)!​.

This follows because the constant c must normalize the pdf to have total probability 1. There is only one such constant and it is given in the formula for the beta distribution.

A similar observation holds for normal distributions, exponential distributions, and so on.

只要一个 [0,1] 上的密度具有 cθa−1(1−θ)b−1 的形式, 它就一定是 Beta(a,b). 不需要再积分求 c: 归一化常数只能取 Beta 公式中的那个值.

原因是总概率必须等于 1, 而满足这个条件的常数唯一. 同样的识别方法也适用于正态、指数等分布: 先认出函数形状, 再直接调用该分布已知的归一化常数.

平坦先验
Aside on flat priors

Slide 6

If you don’t have any prior information of a location parameter like θ, you can use a flat prior also called an uninformative prior.

f(θ)=1

Note: This is the pdf of a Beta(1,1) distribution.

f(θ)∼Beta(1,1) (flat prior)

**flat prior 平坦先验**在 [0,1] 上取常数密度 f(θ)=1, 也就是 Beta(1,1). 任意小区间的先验概率只取决于区间长度, 不偏向某个特定位置.

它常被用作没有明显先验倾向时的起点. 不过「无信息」仍是一种建模选择, 换参数化以后不一定仍然平坦.

Beta 先验例题的设定
Board question preamble: Beta priors

Slide 7

Suppose you are testing a new medical treatment with unknown probability of success θ. You don’t know θ, but your prior belief is that it’s probably not too far from 0.5. You capture this intuition with a Beta(5,5) prior on θ.

To sharpen this distribution you take data and update the prior.

Question on next slide.

新治疗的成功率 θ 未知, 但先验认为它大概不会离 0.5 太远, 于是选用 Beta(5,5). 这条曲线以 0.5 为中心对称, 又保留了对其他成功率的可能判断.

接下来收集患者数据, 目的就是让这条曲线按照证据移动并收窄. 「收窄」表示对 θ 的判断更集中, 不是把先验直接替换成样本成功率.

Bernoulli、Binomial 与 Geometric 更新
Bernoulli, Binomial, and Geometric Updating

3.2 二项随机变量的 Beta 先验与后验
3.2 Beta priors and posteriors for binomial random variables

Page 2

Example 1. Suppose we have a bent coin with unknown probability θ of heads. We toss it 12 times and get 8 heads and 4 tails. Starting with a flat prior, show that the posterior pdf is a Beta(9,5) distribution.

Solution: This is nearly identical to examples from the previous class. We’ll call the data from all 12 tosses x1​. In the following table we call the leading constant factor in the posterior column c2​. Our simple observation will tell us that it has to be the constant factor from the beta pdf.

The data is 8 heads and 4 tails. Since this comes from a binomial(12, θ) distribution, the likelihood p(x1​∣θ)=(812​)θ8(1−θ)4. Thus the Bayesian update table is

例 1 从平坦先验出发, 抛 12 次得到 8 正 4 反. 二项似然为 (812​)θ8(1−θ)4: θ8 对应 8 次正面, (1−θ)4 对应 4 次反面.

要证明后验是 Beta(9,5), 只需把先验密度 1 与似然相乘, 再看结果的幂次. 后验列的常数记作 c2​, 最后由 Beta 的归一化公式确定.

Page 2
hypothesispriorlikelihoodBayes numeratorposterior
θ1⋅dθ(812​)θ8(1−θ)4(812​)θ8(1−θ)4dθc2​θ8(1−θ)4dθ
total1T=(812​)∫01​θ8(1−θ)4dθ1

更新表中, 平坦先验不提供额外的 θ 或 1−θ 因子, 所以 Bayes 分子与似然具有相同的幂次. 分母则在 [0,1] 上对 θ 积分.

归一化以后, 二项系数和积分结果都并入 c2​. 真正决定后验类型的是剩下的 θ8(1−θ)4.

Page 2

For the posterior pdf, our simple observation holds with a=9 and b=5. Therefore the posterior pdf follows a Beta(9, 5) distribution and we have

f(θ∣x1​)=c2​θ8(1−θ)4,c2​=8!4!13!​.

Note: We explicitly included the binomial coefficient (812​) in the likelihood. We could just as easily have given it a name, say c1​, and not bothered making its value explicit.

Beta(a,b) 的两个幂次是 a−1 和 b−1. 现在分别是 8 和 4, 所以 a=9,b=5, 后验就是 Beta(9,5), 归一化常数为 13!/(8!4!).

也可以直接记更新规则: 平坦先验 Beta(1,1) 加 8 次正面、4 次反面, 得到 Beta(1+8,1+4). 二项系数不含 θ, 不影响这个加数规则.

继续投掷与逐次更新
Example 2

Pages 2–3

Now suppose we toss the same coin again, getting n heads and m tails. Using the posterior pdf of the previous example as our new prior pdf, show that the new posterior pdf is that of a Beta(9+n, 5+m) distribution.

Solution: It’s all in the table. We’ll call the data of these n+m additional tosses x2​. This time we won’t make the binomial coefficient explicit. Instead we’ll just call it c3​. Whenever we need a new label we will simply use c with a new subscript.

hyp.priorlikelihoodBayes numeratorposterior
θc2​θ8(1−θ)4dθc3​θn(1−θ)mc2​c3​θn+8(1−θ)m+4dθc4​θn+8(1−θ)m+4dθ
total1T=∫01​c2​c3​θn+8(1−θ)m+4dθ1

Again our simple observation holds and therefore the posterior pdf f(θ∣x1​,x2​)=c4​θn+8(1−θ)m+4 follows a Beta(n+9,m+5) distribution.

第一次更新后的 Beta(9,5) 现在成为新先验. 新数据有 n 正 m 反, 似然再贡献 θn(1−θ)m.

同底数幂相乘时指数相加: θ 的幂次变为 8+n, 1−θ 的幂次变为 4+m. 因此新后验是 Beta(9+n,5+m). 每次得到新数据, 都可以把上一回的后验直接当作下一回的先验.

Page 3

Note: Flat beta. The Beta(1, 1) distribution is the same as the uniform distribution on [0,1], which we have also called the flat prior on θ. This follows by plugging a=1 and b=1 into the definition of the beta distribution, giving f(θ)=1.

把 a=b=1 代入 Beta 密度, 两个幂次都为 0, 密度就变成常数 1. 因此「Beta(1,1)」「均匀分布」和这里的「平坦先验」说的是同一个分布.

Page 3

Summary: If the probability of heads is θ, the number of heads in n+m tosses follows a binomial(n+m,θ) distribution. We have seen that if the prior on θ is a beta distribution then so is the posterior; only the parameters a,b of the beta distribution change! We summarize precisely how they change in a table. We assume the data is n heads and m tails in n+m tosses.

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
θx=(n,m)Beta(a,b)binomial(n+m,θ)Beta(a+n,b+m)
θx=(n,m)c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1dθc2​θn(1−θ)mc3​θa+n−1(1−θ)b+m−1dθ

一般规则是: Beta(a,b) 先验遇到 n 次正面、m 次反面, 后验就是 Beta(a+n,b+m). 第一个参数累计正面数, 第二个参数累计反面数.

逐次更新与一次性合并更新结果相同. 无论分多少批, 最后都是把所有正面数加到 a, 把所有反面数加到 b.

4 共轭先验
4 Conjugate priors

Page 3

The beta distribution is called a conjugate prior for the binomial distribution. This means that if the likelihood function is binomial, then a beta prior gives a beta posterior – this is what we saw in the previous examples. In fact, the beta distribution is a conjugate prior for the Bernoulli and geometric distributions as well.

We will soon see another important example: the normal distribution is its own conjugate prior. In particular, if the likelihood function is normal with known variance, then a normal prior gives a normal posterior.

Beta 分布是二项似然的共轭先验, 因为 Beta 先验经过二项数据更新后仍是 Beta 后验. 同样的关系也存在于 Beta 与 Bernoulli、几何似然之间.

正态分布则是它自己的共轭先验: 数据方差已知且似然为正态时, 正态先验会产生正态后验. 这里的「共轭」描述先验与似然的配合关系, 不是说两个分布图形相似.

Page 3

Conjugate priors are useful because they reduce Bayesian updating to modifying the parameters of the prior distribution (so-called hyperparameters) rather than computing integrals. We saw this for the beta distribution in the last table. For many more examples see: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conjugate_prior_distribution

We now give a definition of conjugate prior. It is best understood through the examples in the subsequent sections.

Definition. Suppose we have data with likelihood function ϕ(x∣θ) depending on a hypothesized parameter θ. Also suppose the prior distribution for θ is one of a family of parametrized distributions. If the posterior distribution for θ is in this family then we say the the family of priors are conjugate priors for the likelihood.

This definition will be illustrated with specific examples in the sections below.

正式定义: 固定一种似然, 如果某个参数化先验族产生的后验仍属于同一族, 这个先验族就是该似然的共轭先验.

好处是更新只需修改超参数, 不必每次计算归一化积分. Beta 更新中的「成功数、失败数相加」就是典型例子. 判断共轭时, 要检查先验与似然相乘后的函数形式, 而不是只凭分布名称猜测.

原文笔误:定义末尾写成 the the family of priors, 多了一个 the, 应为 the family of priors.

5 Beta 先验
5 Beta priors

Pages 3–4

In this section, we will show that the beta distribution is a conjugate prior for binomial, Bernoulli, and geometric likelihoods.

接下来分别列出三种似然的更新表. 三张表都在验证同一件事: 乘积仍保留 Beta 密度的幂次结构, 只是两个幂次按照数据发生变化.

5.1 二项似然
5.1 Binomial likelihood

Page 4

We saw above that the beta distribution is a conjugate prior for the binomial distribution. This means that if the likelihood function is binomial and the prior distribution is beta then the posterior is also beta.

More specifically, suppose that the likelihood follows a binomial(N,θ) distribution where N is known and θ is the (unknown) parameter of interest. We also have that the data x from one trial is an integer between 0 and N. Then for a beta prior we have the following table:

hypoth.datapriorlikelihoodposterior
θxBeta(a,b)binomial(N,θ)Beta(a+x,b+N−x)
θxf(θ)=c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1p(x∣θ)=c2​θx(1−θ)N−xf(θ∣x)=c3​θa+x−1(1−θ)b+N−x−1

固定试验次数 N, 数据 x 是成功次数, 失败次数就是 N−x. Beta(a,b) 先验更新后得到 Beta(a+x,b+N−x).

公式行直接展示指数相加: a−1+x=a+x−1, b−1+N−x=b+N−x−1. 这与前面按正面、反面计数完全等价.

Page 4

The table is simplified by writing the normalizing coefficients as c1​,c2​ and c3​ respectively. If needed, we can recover the values of the c1​ and c2​ by recalling (or looking up) the normalizations of the beta and binomial distributions.

c1​=(a−1)!(b−1)!(a+b−1)!​,c2​=(xN​)=x!(N−x)!N!​,c3​=(a+x−1)!(b+N−x−1)!(a+b+N−1)!​.

表中的 c1​,c2​,c3​ 只是为了避免公式过长. c1​ 是先验 Beta 的归一化常数, c2​ 是二项系数, c3​ 则是更新后 Beta(a+x,b+N−x) 的归一化常数.

实际识别后验时可以先不管这些常数; 如果需要写出完整密度, 再把新参数代入 Beta 的归一化公式即可.

5.2 Bernoulli 似然
5.2 Bernoulli likelihood

Page 4

The beta distribution is a conjugate prior for the Bernoulli distribution. This is actually a special case of the binomial distribution, since Bernoulli(θ) is the same as binomial(1, θ). We do it separately because it is slightly simpler and of special importance. In the table below, we show the updates corresponding to success (x=1) and failure (x=0) on separate rows.

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
θxBeta(a,b)Bernoulli(θ)Beta(a+1,b) or Beta(a,b+1)
θx=1f(θ)=c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1p(x∣θ)=θBeta(a+1,b): f(θ∣x)=c3​θa(1−θ)b−1
θx=0f(θ)=c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1p(x∣θ)=1−θBeta(a,b+1): f(θ∣x)=c4​θa−1(1−θ)b

The constants c1​,c3​ and c4​ have the same formulas as in the previous (binomial likelihood case) with N=1.

Bernoulli 是 N=1 的二项分布. 一次成功 x=1 使第一个参数加 1, 一次失败 x=0 使第二个参数加 1.

因此既可以逐次更新, 也可以先统计总成功数和失败数再一次更新. 两种顺序最后得到同一个 Beta 后验.

5.3 几何似然
5.3 Geometric likelihood

Pages 4–5

Recall that the geometric(θ) distribution describes the probability of x successes before the first failure, where the probability of success on any single independent trial is θ. The corresponding pmf is given by p(x)=θx(1−θ).

Now suppose that we have a data point x, and our hypothesis θ is that x is drawn from a geometric(θ) distribution. From the table we see that the beta distribution is a conjugate prior for a geometric likelihood as well:

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
θxBeta(a,b)geometric(θ)Beta(a+x,b+1)
θxf(θ)=c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1p(x∣θ)=θx(1−θ)f(θ∣x)=c3​θa+x−1(1−θ)b

这里的几何分布记录第一次失败前的成功次数 x. 其似然是 θx(1−θ): 前面有 x 次成功, 最后以一次失败停止.

Beta 先验乘上这个似然后, 第一个参数增加 x, 第二个参数增加 1, 所以后验为 Beta(a+x,b+1). 它仍然是 Beta, 因为乘积只改变了两个幂次.

Page 5

At first it may seem strange that the beta distribution is a conjugate prior for both the binomial and geometric distributions. The key reason is that the geometric likelihood is proportional to a binomial likelihood as a function of θ. Let’s illustrate this in a concrete example.

Example 3. While traveling through the Mushroom Kingdom, Mario and Luigi find some rather unusual coins. They agree on a prior of f(θ)∼Beta(5,5) for the probability of heads, though they disagree on what experiment to run to investigate θ further.

(a) Mario decides to flip a coin 5 times. He gets four heads in five flips.

(b) Luigi decides to flip a coin until the first tail. He gets four heads before the first tail.

Show that Mario and Luigi will arrive at the same posterior on θ, and calculate this posterior.

Mario 固定抛 5 次, 得到 4 正 1 反; Luigi 一直抛到第一次反面, 也得到 4 正 1 反. 两人的试验停止规则不同, 但当前数据关于 θ 的似然形状相同.

关键就在「作为 θ 的函数成比例」. 二项似然多一个组合数, 几何似然没有这个组合数, 但组合数不依赖 θ, 归一化时会消去.

Page 5

Solution: We will show that both Mario and Luigi find the posterior pdf for θ is a Beta(9, 6) distribution.

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
Marioθx=4Beta(5, 5)binomial(5, θ)c3​θ8(1−θ)5
Luigiθx=4Beta(5, 5)geometric(θ)c3​θ8(1−θ)5

Since both Mario and Luigi’s posteriors have the form of a Beta(9, 6) distribution that’s what they both must be. The normalizing factor must be the same in both cases because it’s determined by requiring the total probability to be 1.

两人的未归一化后验都为 θ8(1−θ)5, 所以都是 Beta(9,6). 从 Beta(5,5) 出发, 4 次成功使第一个参数加 4, 1 次失败使第二个参数加 1.

归一化常数也相同, 因为它只由最终密度形状和「积分为 1」决定. 这个例子是 **likelihood principle 似然原理**的具体体现: 成比例的似然导致相同后验.

Beta 先验课堂题
Board question: Beta priors

Slide 8
  • Beta(a,b): f(θ)=(a−1)!(b−1)!(a+b−1)!​θa−1(1−θ)b−1
  • Treatment has prior f(θ)∼Beta(5,5)

(a) Suppose you test it on 25 patients and have 20 successes.

– Find the posterior distribution on θ.

– Identify the type of the posterior distribution.

(b) Suppose you recorded the order of the results and got

SSSSF SSSSSF F SSSF SF SSSSSSSS

(20 S and 5 F). Find the posterior based on this data.

(c) Using your answer to (b) give an integral for the posterior predictive probability of success with the next patient.

按题目文字给出的 20 次成功、5 次失败, Beta(5,5) 更新为 Beta(25,10). 只记录总数与记录完整顺序, 只要成功和失败计数相同, 后验就相同.

第 (c) 问要求写下一位患者成功的后验预测概率. 若采用题目预期的 Beta(25,10), 积分是 ∫01​θf(θ∣x)dθ, 也就是后验均值 25/35=5/7.

不过幻灯片印出的序列与括号里的计数不一致. 若严格按序列计数, 应使用 21 次成功, 后验和预测概率也会随之改变, 见下方红框.

幻灯片前后不一致:题干写 20 S and 5 F, 但序列按组计数实际有 21 个 S 和 5 个 F, 共 26 个结果. 按题目预期计数更新为 Beta(25,10); 若严格按印出的序列更新, 则应为 Beta(26,10), 下一位患者成功的后验预测概率也相应为 26/36=13/18, 不是 5/7.

共轭先验总结
Conjugate priors

Slide 9

We had

  • Prior f(θ)dθ=Beta(5,5): Beta distribution
  • Likelihood p(x∣θ): binomial distribution x=20 success, 5 failure
  • Posterior f(θ∣x)dθ=Beta(25,10): Beta distribution

The Beta distribution is called a conjugate prior for the binomial likelihood.

That is, the Beta prior becomes a Beta posterior and repeated updating is easy! Only the parameters have been changed to reflect the data.

这张总结页采用题目预期的 20 次成功、5 次失败, 因而参数从 (5,5) 变为 (25,10). 先验和后验都属于 Beta 分布族, 只是超参数反映了新增数据.

后验均值为 25/35, 比先验均值 1/2 更偏向成功. 参数总和也由 10 增到 35, 分布会更加集中.

更多 Beta 更新概念题
Concept question: More Beta

Slide 10

Suppose your prior f(θ) in the bent coin example is Beta(6, 8). You flip the coin 7 times, getting 2 heads and 5 tails. What is the posterior pdf f(θ∣x)?

  1. Beta(2, 5)
  2. Beta(11, 10)
  3. Beta(6, 8)
  4. Beta(8, 13)

正确选项是 (d) Beta(8,13). 两次正面使第一个参数由 6 增加到 8, 五次反面使第二个参数由 8 增加到 13.

常见错误是把数据本身当作后验参数, 或把两个更新方向对调. 记住 θ 对应成功, 1−θ 对应失败即可.

强先验与截断后验
Strong Priors and Truncated Posteriors

强先验概念题
Concept question: strong priors

Slide 11

Say we have a bent coin with unknown probability of heads θ. We are convinced that θ≤0.7.

Our prior is uniform on [0,0.7] and 0 from 0.7 to 1. We flip the coin 65 times and get 60 heads. Which of the graphs below is the posterior pdf for θ?

先验在 [0,0.7] 上均匀, 在 0.7 以上严格为 0. 观察到 60 正 5 反后, 允许区间内的未归一化后验与 θ60(1−θ)5 成正比.

但后验不能直接写成完整的 Beta(61,6), 因为先验在 0.7 以上为 0, 乘积在那里仍为 0. 归一化也只能在 [0,0.7] 上进行, 得到的是**截断后验**.

读图:应选 Graph C. 似然把质量推向较大的 θ, 所以在允许区间右端附近形成尖峰, 但超过 0.7 后必须立即归零. 数据不能让先验为 0 的区域重新获得概率.

连续数据与连续假设
Continuous Data and Continuous Hypotheses

6 连续假设与连续数据的贝叶斯更新
6 Bayesian updating with continuous hypotheses and continuous data

Page 5

The idea here is essentially identical to the Bayesian updating we’ve already done. The only change is, with a continuous likelihood, we have to compute the total probability of the data (i.e. sum of the Bayes numerator column, i.e. normalizing factor) as an integral instead of a sum. We will cover this briefly. For those who are interested, a bit more detail is given in an optional note.

连续数据与连续假设的更新思路和以前相同, 仍先验乘似然再归一化. 差别在于数据的总密度要通过对参数积分得到, 而不是对有限假设求和.

这一节承接上一讲的补充讲义, 为正态—正态更新先统一记号.

Pages 5–6

Notation.

  • Hypotheses θ. For continuous hypotheses, this really means that we hypothesize that the parameter is in a small interval of size dθ around θ.
  • Data x. For continuous data, this really means that the data is in a small interval of size dx around x.
  • Prior f(θ)dθ. This is our initial belief about the probability that the parameter is in a small interval of size dθ around θ.
  • Likelihood ϕ(x∣θ). So the probability that the data is in a small interval of size dx around x, ASSUMING the hypothesis θ, is ϕ(x∣θ)dx
  • Posterior f(θ∣x)dθ. This is the (calculated) probability that the parameter is in a small interval of size dθ around θ, GIVEN the data x.

参数与数据都要用小区间理解. 先验 f(θ)dθ 是参数小区间的概率, 似然 ϕ(x∣θ)dx 是给定参数后数据小区间的概率, 后验 f(θ∣x)dθ 则是看到数据后参数小区间的概率.

更新时数据已经固定, dx 是共同因子, 可以在表中省略. dθ 保留下来, 提醒我们还要沿整个参数空间积分.

Page 6
hypoth.priorlikelihoodBayes numeratorposterior
θf(θ)dθϕ(x∣θ)ϕ(x∣θ)f(θ)dθf(θ∣x)dθ=ϕ(x)ϕ(x∣θ)f(θ)dθ​
total1no sumϕ(x)=∫ϕ(x∣θ)f(θ)dθ1
(integrate over θ)= prior prob. density for data x

To summarize: the prior probabilities of hypotheses and the likelihoods of data given hypothesis were given; the Bayes numerator is the product of prior and likelihood; the total likelihood ϕ(x) is the integral of the probabilities in the Bayes numerator column; we divide by ϕ(x) to normalize the Bayes numerator.

表中的分母 ϕ(x) 是数据的边际密度: 把每个参数下的似然按先验加权, 再对所有 θ 积分. 后验密度就是先验密度乘似然, 再除以这个边际密度.

似然列的 no sum 仍表示沿假设方向求和没有归一化意义. 真正需要积分为 1 的是先验和后验这些定义在参数上的密度.

正态—正态共轭更新
Normal-Normal Conjugate Updating

7 正态产生正态
7 Normal begets normal

Pages 6–7

We now turn to an important example of coninuous-continuous updating: the normal distribution is its own conjugate prior. In particular, if the likelihood function is normal with known variance, then a normal prior gives a normal posterior. Now both the hypotheses and the data are continuous.

Suppose we have a measurement x∼N(θ,σ2) where the variance σ2 is known. That is, the mean θ is our unknown parameter of interest and we are given that the likelihood comes from a normal distribution with variance σ2. If we choose a normal prior pdf

f(θ)∼N(μprior​,σprior2​)

then the posterior pdf is also normal: f(θ∣x)∼N(μpost​,σpost2​) where

σpost2​μpost​​=σprior2​μprior​​+σ2x​,σpost2​1​=σprior2​1​+σ21​.(1)

现在测量值 x∼N(θ,σ2), 其中数据方差 σ2 已知, 未知的是均值 θ. 给 θ 配一个正态先验后, 后验仍是正态.

公式 (1) 用 **precision 精度**表示更新. 精度就是方差的倒数: 后验精度等于先验精度加数据精度; 后验的「精度加权均值」也等于两项相应贡献之和.

这组公式避免了每次重新配方. 先验和数据各自提供一份信息, 后验把两份信息合并.

原文笔误:本节首句把 continuous-continuous 写成 coninuous-continuous, 漏了 t, 应为 continuous-continuous.

Page 6

The following form of these formulas is easier to read and shows that μpost​ is a weighted average between μprior​ and the data x.

a=σprior2​1​,b=σ21​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bx​,σpost2​=a+b1​.(2)

公式 (2) 令 a 为先验精度, b 为数据精度. 后验均值是 (aμprior​+bx)/(a+b), 后验方差是 1/(a+b).

因此后验均值位于先验均值与观测值之间. 哪一方精度更高, 也就是方差更小, 哪一方的权重就更大. 后验精度增加, 所以后验方差变小.

Pages 6–7

With these formulas in mind, we can express the update via the table:

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
θxf(θ)∼N(μprior​,σprior2​)ϕ(x∣θ)∼N(θ,σ2)f(θ∣x)∼N(μpost​,σpost2​)
θxc1​exp(−2σprior2​(θ−μprior​)2​)c2​exp(−2σ2(x−θ)2​)c3​exp(−2σpost2​(θ−μpost​)2​)

We leave the proof of the general formulas to the problem set. It is an involved algebraic manipulation which is essentially the same as the following numerical example.

更新表的第一行写分布类型, 第二行写密度形状. 先验和似然的指数都是关于 θ 的二次式, 相乘后仍是二次式, 配方以后又是正态密度.

一般公式的证明留到练习单. 下面的数值例子把同样的代数完整做一遍, 用来理解公式并不是凭空出现的.

正态更新的数值例
Example 4

Page 7

Suppose we have prior θ∼N(4,8), and likelihood function x∼N(θ,5). Suppose also that we have one measurement x1​=3. Show the posterior distribution is normal.

Solution: We will show this by grinding through the algebra which involves completing the square.

prior: f(θ)=c1​e−(θ−4)2/16;likelihood: ϕ(x1​∣θ)=c2​e−(x1​−θ)2/10=c2​e−(3−θ)2/10

We multiply the prior and likelihood to get the posterior:

f(θ∣x1​)=c3​e−(θ−4)2/16e−(3−θ)2/10=c3​exp(−16(θ−4)2​−10(3−θ)2​)

本例先验是 N(4,8), 数据模型方差为 5, 观测为 3. 注意正态记号的第二个参数是方差, 所以先验指数分母是 2×8=16, 似然指数分母是 2×5=10.

先验与似然相乘后, 两个指数相加. 接下来的任务只是把关于 θ 的二次式配成平方, 从而读出后验正态的均值与方差.

Page 7

We complete the square in the exponent

−16(θ−4)2​−10(3−θ)2​=−805(θ−4)2+8(3−θ)2​=−8013θ2−88θ+152​=−80/13(θ−44/13)2+152/13−(44/13)2​.

Therefore the posterior is

f(θ∣x1​)=c3​e−80/13(θ−44/13)2+152/13−(44/13)2​=c4​e−80/13(θ−44/13)2​.

This has the form of the pdf for N(44/13,40/13). QED

配方分三步看: 先通分到分母 80; 再展开得到 13θ2−88θ+152; 最后提出 13, 配成中心为 44/13 的平方.

不含 θ 的余项并入常数 c4​. 剩余指数的分母是 80/13=2×40/13, 对照正态标准形 2σpost2​, 得到后验 N(44/13,40/13).

Page 7

For practice we check this against the formulas (2).

μprior​=4,σprior2​=8,σ2=5⇒a=1/8,b=1/5. Therefore

μpost​=a+baμprior​+bx​=1344​≈3.38,σpost2​=a+b1​=1340​≈3.08.

用公式核对: 先验精度 a=1/8, 数据精度 b=1/5. 代入加权平均, 后验均值为 44/13≈3.38, 后验方差为 40/13≈3.08, 与配方结果一致.

数据精度比先验精度大, 所以后验均值更靠近数据 3, 而不是先验均值 4. 实际计算时通常直接使用公式, 不必重复完整配方.

7.1 加权平均的含义
7.1 A word on weighted averages

Page 8

The updating formula 2 gives μpost​ as a weighted average of the μprior​ and the data. The weight on μprior​ is a/(a+b), and the weight on the data is b/(a+b). These weights are always positive numbers summing to 1. If b is very large (that is, if the data has a tiny variance) then most of the weight is on the data. If a is very large (that is, σprior2​ is small, i.e. if you are very confident in your prior) then most of the weight is on the prior.

In the above example the variance on the prior was bigger than the variance on the data, so a was smaller than b; so the weight was mostly on the data. The posterior 3.38 for the mean was closer to the data 3 than to the prior 4 for the mean.

先验权重是 a/(a+b), 数据权重是 b/(a+b), 两者都为正且总和为 1. 所以后验均值不会跑到先验均值与数据值之外.

数据方差很小, 说明测量精确, b 大, 数据权重就大; 先验方差很小, 说明原先判断很有把握, a 大, 先验权重就大. 上例中数据更精确, 因此 3.38 离 3 更近.

7.2 正态—正态更新示例
7.2 Examples of normal-normal updating

Page 8

Example 5. Suppose that we know the data x∼N(θ,4/9) and we have prior N(0,1). We get one data value x=6.5. Describe the changes to the pdf for θ in updating from the prior to the posterior.

Solution: μprior​=0,σprior2​=1,σ2=4/9. So, using the updating formulas 2 we have

a=1,b=49​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bx​=4.5,σpost2​=a+b1​=134​.

例 5 的先验为 N(0,1), 数据方差为 4/9, 观测为 6.5. 先验精度 a=1, 数据精度 b=9/4, 所以数据的权重更大.

更新后均值为 4.5, 位于 0 与 6.5 之间并更靠近数据; 方差降为 4/13. 后验既移动了中心, 也收窄了分布.

Page 8

Here is a graph of the prior and posterior pdfs with the data point marked by a red line

We see that the posterior mean is closer to the data point than the prior mean We also see that the posterior distribution is taller and narrower than the prior, i.e. it has a smaller variance. The smaller variance says that we are now more certain about where the value of θ lies.

读图:蓝色先验中心在 0, 红色数据线在 6.5, 橙色后验中心移到 4.5. 后验没有直接等于观测值, 因为先验仍有权重.

后验曲线更高、更窄, 表示方差减小. 这里的「更确定」指我们对未知参数 θ 的位置更有把握, 不是说之后每次测量都会得到同一个数.

Pages 8–9

Example 6. Use the formulas 2 to show that for normal-normal Bayesian updating we have:

  1. The posterior mean is always between the data point and the prior mean.
  2. The posterior variance is smaller than both the prior variance and σ. That is, our posterior uncetainty is smaller than both our prior uncertainty and the uncertainty in the data.

Solution: Using the update formulas 2, we have The posterior mean is the weighted average of the prior mean and the data, so it must lie between the prior mean and the data.

例 6 要证明两个一般结论. 第一, 后验均值是先验均值与数据的正权重平均, 所以必定位于二者之间.

第二要比较方差. 后验精度是 a+b, 大于单独的 a 或 b; 取倒数后, 后验方差就小于先验方差, 也小于数据方差.

Page 9

Also, the posterior variance is

σpost2​=a+b1​<a1​=σprior2​.

That is the posterior has smaller variance than the prior, i.e. data makes us more certain about where in its range θ lies.

Likewise σpost2​=1/(a+b)<1/b=σ2. So, the posterior variance is smaller than σ2.

因为 b>0, 有 1/(a+b)<1/a, 所以后验方差小于先验方差. 同理, 因为 a>0, 也有 1/(a+b)<1/b=σ2.

这两条不等式来自精度相加, 不需要知道具体的先验均值或观测值. 新数据总会增加关于 θ 的信息, 因而在这个模型下后验方差必然下降.

原文笔误:Example 6 的 uncetainty 拼写错误, 应为 uncertainty. Example 5 末句 prior mean We 在句号前漏了句点, 应分成两句: ... prior mean. We ....

7.3 多个数据点
7.3 More than one data point

Page 9

Example 7. Suppose we have data x1​,x2​,x3​. Use the formulas (1) to update sequentially.

Solution: Let’s label the prior mean and variance as μ0​ and σ02​. The updated means and variances will be μi​ and σi2​. In sequence we have

σ12​1​=σ02​1​+σ21​,σ12​μ1​​=σ02​μ0​​+σ2x1​​;
σ22​1​=σ12​1​+σ21​=σ02​1​+σ22​,σ22​μ2​​=σ12​μ1​​+σ2x2​​=σ02​μ0​​+σ2x1​+x2​​;
σ32​1​=σ22​1​+σ21​=σ02​1​+σ23​,σ32​μ3​​=σ22​μ2​​+σ2x3​​=σ02​μ0​​+σ2x1​+x2​+x3​​.

多个数据点可以逐次更新. 每加入一个观测, 后验精度增加 1/σ2, 精度加权均值的分子增加 xi​/σ2.

处理三个数据后, 数据总精度是 3/σ2, 数据贡献的分子是 (x1​+x2​+x3​)/σ2. 每次把上一回后验当作新先验, 与前面 Beta 的逐次更新是同一个思想.

Page 9

The example generalizes to n data values x1​,…,xn​:

Normal-normal update formulas for n data points

σpost2​μpost​​=σprior2​μprior​​+σ2nxˉ​,σpost2​1​=σprior2​1​+σ2n​,xˉ=nx1​+⋯+xn​​.(3)

Again we give the easier to read form, showing μpost​ is a weighted average of μprior​ and the sample average xˉ:

a=σprior2​1​,b=σ2n​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bxˉ​,σpost2​=a+b1​.(4)

对 n 个独立同方差数据, 数据总精度为 n/σ2. 因为数据之和等于 nxˉ, 更新公式只需样本均值 xˉ 和样本量 n.

公式 (4) 令 b=n/σ2, 后验均值就变成先验均值与 xˉ 的加权平均. 逐次更新与一次性合并更新完全等价.

Page 9

Interpretation: μpost​ is a weighted average of μprior​ and xˉ. If the number of data points is large then the weight b is large and xˉ will have a strong influence on the posterior. If σprior2​ is small then the weight a is large and μprior​ will have a strong influence on the posterior. To summarize:

  1. Lots of data has a big influence on the posterior.
  2. High certainty (low variance) in the prior has a big influence on the posterior.
  3. The actual posterior is a balance of these two influences.

数据量越大, b=n/σ2 越大, 样本均值对后验的影响越强. 先验方差越小, a 越大, 先验均值的影响越强.

后验是在「数据多少与精度」和「先验强度」之间折中. 当数据不断累积时, 数据权重通常会占主导; 但少量数据下, 强先验仍可能有明显影响.

正态先验与正态似然总结
Updating with normal prior and normal likelihood

Slides 12–13

A normal prior is conjugate to a normal likelihood with known σ.

  • Data: x1​,x2​,…,xn​
  • Normal likelihood. x1​,x2​,…,xn​∼N(θ,σ2). Assume θ is our unknown parameter of interest, σ is known.
  • Normal prior. θ∼N(μprior​,σprior2​).
  • Normal Posterior. θ∼N(μpost​,σpost2​).
  • We have simple updating formulas that allow us to avoid complicated algebra or integrals (see next slide).
a=σprior2​1​,b=σ2n​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bxˉ​,σpost2​=a+b1​.

Formulas:

a=σprior2​1​,b=σ2n​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bxˉ​,σpost2​=a+b1​.

Notes:

  • Posterior mean μpost​ is a weighted average of the data mean and the prior mean.
  • Bigger n puts more weight on the data.
  • Variance always decreases, i.e. σprior2​<σpost2​.

The update table with continuous data looks the same as always.

幻灯片把正态—正态更新再汇总一次. 后验均值按精度加权, n 越大, 数据均值权重越大; 后验精度等于先验精度与数据总精度之和.

因此方差应当下降, 而不是上升. 幻灯片 Notes 中的不等号方向写反了, 正确结论与前面公式 (4) 一致.

幻灯片错误:Notes 把方差下降写成 σ_prior² < σ_post², 方向反了. 正确应为 σ_post² < σ_prior²; 同时后验方差也小于数据方差 σ2, 因为精度相加而非相减.

For data x1​,…,xn​ with data mean xˉ=(x1​+⋯+xn​)/n

a=σprior2​1​,b=σ2n​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bxˉ​,σpost2​=a+b1​.

Suppose θ is our parameter of interest with prior θ∼N(4,22).

(a) Identify μprior​,σprior​,σ,n, and xˉ.

正态后验图形判断
Concept question: Normal priors, normal likelihood

Slides 15–16

Blue graph = prior, Red lines = data in order: 3, 9, 12

(a) Which plot is the posterior to just the first data value?

(b) Which graph is posterior to all 3 data values?

罚球命中率的正态更新
Board question: normal/normal

Slide 17

For data x1​,…,xn​ with data mean xˉ=(x1​+⋯+xn​)/n

a=σprior2​1​,b=σ2n​,μpost​=a+baμprior​+bxˉ​,σpost2​=a+b1​.

Question. On a basketball team the average career free throw percentage over all players follows a N(75,62) distribution. In a given year individual players free throw percentage is N(θ,42) where θ is their career average.

This season Sophie Lie made 85 percent of her free throws. What is the posterior expected value of her career percentage θ?

球员生涯平均命中率的先验为 N(75,36), 本季表现围绕生涯平均的方差为 16. 只有一个赛季数据, 所以 n=1,xˉ=85.

后验期望是 (75/36+85/16)/(1/36+1/16)=1065/13≈81.9231. 后验方差为 144/13≈11.0769.

数据方差 16 小于先验方差 36, 数据精度更高, 因此后验均值更靠近 85, 但仍向先验的 75 拉回了一部分.

似然原理与共轭组合
The Likelihood Principle and Conjugate Pairs

似然原理讨论
Table discussion: likelihood principle

Slide 18

Suppose the prior has been set. Let x1​ and x2​ be two sets of data.

Which of the following are true?

  1. If the likelihoods ϕ(x1​∣θ) and ϕ(x2​∣θ) are the same then they result in the same posterior.
  2. If the likelihoods ϕ(x1​∣θ) and ϕ(x2​∣θ) are proportional (as functions of θ) then they result in the same posterior.
  3. If two likelihood functions are proportional then they are equal.

(a) 和 (b) 正确, (c) 错误. 固定先验后, 如果两份数据的似然作为 θ 的函数完全相同, 后验当然相同; 如果只相差一个不含 θ 的正常数, 归一化时这个常数也会约掉, 后验仍相同.

但成比例不等于逐点相等. 例如 θ4(1−θ) 与 (45​)θ4(1−θ) 相差 5 倍, 作为 θ 的函数并不相等, 却产生相同后验.

共轭先验汇总
Conjugate priors

Slide 19

A prior is conjugate to a likelihood if the posterior is the same type of distribution as the prior. Updating becomes algebra instead of calculus.

hypothesisdatapriorlikelihoodposterior
Bernoulli/Betaθ∈[0,1]xbeta(a,b)Bernoulli(θ)beta(a+1,b) or beta(a,b+1)
θx=1c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1θc3​θa(1−θ)b−1
θx=0c1​θa−1(1−θ)b−11−θc3​θa−1(1−θ)b
Binomial/Betaθ∈[0,1]xbeta(a,b)binomial(N,θ)beta(a+x,b+N−x)
(fixed N)θxc1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1c2​θx(1−θ)N−xc3​θa+x−1(1−θ)b+N−x−1
Geometric/Betaθ∈[0,1]xbeta(a,b)geometric(θ)beta(a+x,b+1)
θxc1​θa−1(1−θ)b−1θx(1−θ)c3​θa+x−1(1−θ)b
Normal/Normalθ∈(−∞,∞)xN(μprior​,σprior2​)N(θ,σ2)N(μpost​,σpost2​)
(fixed σ2)θxc1​exp(−(θ−μprior​)2/(2σprior2​))c2​exp(−(x−θ)2/(2σ2))c3​exp(−(θ−μpost​)2/(2σpost2​))

There are many other likelihood/conjugate prior pairs.

汇总表把四组共轭关系放在一起. 前三种似然都通过 θ 与 1−θ 的幂次更新 Beta 参数; 已知方差的正态似然则通过精度更新正态参数.

所谓「把微积分变成代数」, 就是不再每次计算归一化积分, 而是做参数加法或精度加权. 表外还有很多其他共轭组合, 判断方法仍然是检查乘积的函数形式.

共轭先验判断题
Finger question: conjugate priors

Slide 20

Which of the following likelihood/prior pairs are conjugate?

  1. Exponential/Normal: θ∈[0,∞), prior N(μprior​,σprior2​), likelihood θe−θx.
  2. Exponential/Gamma: θ∈[0,∞), prior Gamma(a,b), likelihood θe−θx.
  3. Binomial/Normal: θ∈[0,1], prior N(μprior​,σprior2​), likelihood binomial(N,θ) (fixed N).

1. none   2. a   3. b   4. c   5. a,b   6. a,c   7. b,c   8. a,b,c

正确选项是 3, 只有 (b) 共轭. Gamma 先验含 θa−1e−bθ, 乘上指数似然 θe−θx 后得到 θae−(b+x)θ, 仍是 Gamma 形状, 参数更新为 a+1 与 b+x.

(a) 中正态先验乘指数似然后, 不会变成关于 θ 的正态密度; (c) 中正态先验乘二项似然后, 也不会变成正态密度. 因此它们不共轭.

做这种题不要只认分布名称, 要把先验与似然的核乘起来, 看能否重新整理成原来的分布族.
